name: ChatGPT: Close Retained Tab
summary: Close exactly the retained ChatGPT tab named by --tab-ref.
description: Terminal cleanup for a ChatGPT handoff tab retained with --keep-tab-open. The caller must provide --tab-ref; its browser instance and numeric tab id are resolved together before the extension removes that exact tab. A tab that is already gone is a successful no-op.

help.summary: Close one retained ChatGPT handoff tab by exact tab reference.

examples.description: Close the retained tab without touching a same-numbered tab in another browser instance.

returns: { tabId, closed, already_missing }. already_missing=true is a successful idempotent cleanup.
notes: This workflow has no current-tab or active-tab fallback. Omit --tab-ref and it reports no_tab_id_available rather than closing an unrelated tab.
